collection.credit:
🌴 Role Models and Good Examples — 40 New Isola Events

Forty original events for your Virtual Villagers anthology, numbered RM-01 through RM-40. Each has three or four choices, with two possible outcomes per choice. The events emphasize everyday integrity, compassion, fairness, responsibility, and respect without requiring perfect outcomes.

ledger.text: EVENT RM-33  -  THE PLANT BESIDE THE PATH SETUP:
ledger.why: the event's number and title (the title) and the SETUP: marker; the source puts the whole event on one line

collection.description: A builder preparing to repair a walkway discovers a small flowering plant growing directly beside the work area.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A builder preparing to repair a walkway discovers a small flowering plant growing directly beside the work area.

choices.label: Adjust the repair to avoid the plant.
Ask a gardener whether the plant can be moved safely.
Delay the work briefly while inspecting the area.
Invite apprentices to suggest a solution.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The walkway is repaired without disturbing the flowers.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The change requires extra work, but the builder finds a suitable arrangement.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The gardener recommends leaving it undisturbed until flowering ends.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The gardener identifies a suitable place nearby and carefully relocates it.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The builder discovers that only a small section needs immediate repair.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The walkway is unsafe to leave unfinished, so the builder protects the plant as well as possible.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: An apprentice proposes a simple adjustment that preserves the plant.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The apprentices learn that practical building decisions sometimes involve competing needs.
